name: chessgenres
title: chess, but in different genres
blurb: chess reimagined as other game genres. tower defense with a very large queen as the final boss, a city builder (chess city 2000), an autobattler where pieces fight on their own, a balatro-style roguelike where pieces are poker hands, and an idle clicker (chess factory) that climbs from pawns to a dragon assembler making 1000 a second, and a final fantasy tactics-style rpg where a party of pieces fights a dragon built from chess pieces, plus a metal gear solid-style stealth game (chess solid) where a lone king sneaks past patrolling guards, and an open-world crime spree (grand chess auto) where you carjack pieces and outrun chess cops. asked for by bisks.net, tvanl.bsky.social and shimmermathlabs.com.
